description: This file defines the PolicyBuilder interface, which provides a fluent API for constructing and modifying Policy objects within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes nested interfaces for label-scoped building and methods for setting, updating, and removing policy entries, subjects, resources, permissions, and metadata such as IDs and timestamps.

classes.name: PolicyBuilder
classes.description: Interface providing a fluent builder API for creating and modifying Policy objects, with nested interface LabelScoped for label-scoped modifications.

classes.name: PolicyBuilder.LabelScoped
classes.description: Sub-interface extending PolicyBuilder with awareness of a specific Label scope, allowing modifications focused on that label.

methods.name: forLabel
methods.description: Creates a label-scoped PolicyBuilder where the label can be omitted in methods.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the Policy ID; deprecated in favor of setting a typed PolicyId.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the Policy ID using a PolicyId object.

methods.name: setLifecycle
methods.description: Sets the lifecycle information for the policy.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Sets the revision number of the policy.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Sets the revision with a PolicyRevision object.

methods.name: setModified
methods.description: Sets the last modified timestamp.

methods.name: setCreated
methods.description: Sets the creation timestamp, added in version 1.2.0.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a PolicyEntry, replacing any existing entry with the same label.

methods.name: setAll
methods.description: Sets multiple PolicyEntries, replacing any existing entries with matching labels.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes an entry by label.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes an entry by PolicyEntry.

methods.name: removeAll
methods.description: Removes entries matching the given PolicyEntries.

methods.name: setSubjectsFor
methods.description: Sets subjects for a specific label.

methods.name: setSubjectFor
methods.description: Sets a subject for a specific label, by issuer, subject, and type.

methods.name: setSubjectFor
methods.description: Sets a subject for a label directly from a Subject object.

methods.name: removeSubjectFor
methods.description: Removes a subject by issuer and subject from a label.

methods.name: removeSubjectFor
methods.description: Removes a Subject object from a label.

methods.name: setResourcesFor
methods.description: Assigns resources to a label, replacing existing ones.

methods.name: setResourceFor
methods.description: Assigns a resource to a label.

methods.name: removeResourceFor
methods.description: Removes a resource key from a label.

methods.name: removeResourceFor
methods.description: Removes a resource object from a label.

methods.name: setPermissionsFor
methods.description: Sets effected permissions for a resource key in a label.

methods.name: setGrantedPermissionsFor
methods.description: Sets 'granted' permissions for a resource in a label, using resource type and path.

methods.name: setGrantedPermissionsFor
methods.description: Sets 'granted' permissions for a resource key in a label.

methods.name: setGrantedPermissionsFor
methods.description: Sets 'granted' permissions for a resource, identified by ResourceKey, in a label.

methods.name: setRevokedPermissionsFor
methods.description: Sets 'revoked' permissions for a resource in a label.

methods.name: setRevokedPermissionsFor
methods.description: Sets 'revoked' permissions for a resource key in a label.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs an immutable Policy object with the current builder state.
